authority: The four-row structural smoke population of cell ROLL-AA. The gate knows nothing about parent rosters, so those four rows need a committed receipt of their own (the GEPA smoke-roster precedent).

d1_supplement.note: the R01 D1 media supplement is NOT rebuilt for R01C. It closes over all 800 parent recordings, a strict SUPERSET of R01C's 625, and contracts.gate_media_identity._d1_media_supplement_records verifies the supplement's own integrity and then looks each FLOWN id up in it -- it never requires an exact cover. The R01C runtime view therefore carries the parent's supplement triple verbatim.

draw_method: No draw. This receipt is a pure SELECTION of the parent receipt's frozen items: every surviving item is the parent's item verbatim, in the parent's order (ascending sample_id, as core.roster.freeze_roster left it). The seed is the parent's and is carried for provenance only -- no rng is consulted anywhere in this build.

knowledge_source_guard.asserted: set(R01C sample ids) & set(composite source_sample_ids) == set(); the exact intersection rails.runner.run_speech_native_agent_loop computes before it dispatches a single row
knowledge_source_guard.derivation: core.config.compose of the ROLL-1 cell's four fragments, then rails.knowledge_stores.load_knowledge_store_binding; the guard set is the composite snapshot's source_sample_ids (the union over composed stores, rails.knowledge_stores._composite). The dataset fragment cannot move this set: only knowledge_stores feeds it.

roster_role_note: construction: ROLL-AA reads no gold at runtime and produces no admission verdict. These TRAIN rows carry construction gold that the OFFLINE read scores the two Solver samples against, exactly as cell ROLL-1's rows do; the flight itself is the locked plan, unchanged, with a two-sample greedy Solver group.
selection_rule: The FIRST 4 items of docs/receipts/rosters/slurp-stage3-roll-aa-r01c-200-v1.json -- equivalently of docs/receipts/rosters/slurp-stage3-construction-r01c.json -- in the parent's own order; order preserved. These are the same four rows cell ROLL-1's own smoke flies.
stratum_coverage_note: A PREFIX of an ascending-sample_id roster is NOT scenario-stratified: these 4 rows cover 4 of the parent's 18 scenario strata (alarm, audio, datetime, takeaway). The selection rule was specified as the first-N prefix and is registered as such; the preregistration's own 'What this null does not measure' section states the consequence, and the alternative (a stratified 200) is recorded there as a decision NOT taken.
